comments.author: medell
comments.story: After WhatsApp: An Insider’s View on What’s Next in Messaging
comments.text: His point about country usage patterns even applies to the US and Canada. I remember in Canada when most of my friends were on ICQ (and the ubiquitious "uh oh!") and then the slow switch to MSN. Yet the majority of my American friends used AOL Instant Messenger.
